thread:
jessica_cs: Heads-up: Brightline renewal in 12 days. They're seeing intermittent webhook delivery failures (timeouts + 5xx) and slower embedding responses. Customer says this is causing job failures in their ingestion pipeline — renewal might be at risk if we don't stabilize by next week. Ticket: #CS-3421.

mike_se: Looking into logs now. I see delivery spikes around 02:05 UTC with a bunch of `connection reset by peer` and long tail latencies on embedding calls (p50 ~ 120ms -> p95 ~ 900ms). Could be a batching/kafka backlog or autoscale lag.

rana_devops: thx for the ping. I'll check the Dedicated pool metrics and autoscaler events. If it's autoscale latency we can add a short-term surge capacity. Giving a quick healthcheck now.

ollie_support: FYI customer mentioned they retried 3x and then switched to a manual retry, but their SLA for ingestion is strict. They're asking for an ETA on a fix because procurement wants to finalize the contract. :( :frowning_face:

mike_se: snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-16T02:05:12Z ERR webhook send timeout id=bf3a status=504 target=webhook.brightline.com
2026-03-16T02:05:13Z WARN embed latency model=redwood-small p95=912ms
```
Also seeing a small uptick in per-worker OOMs last night. Might be related to a config rollback we did for quantization.

rana_devops: I can spin a temporary extra node group on Dedicated for Brightline's tenant and route their traffic there for next 72h while we root cause. Need confirmation from CS and legal that we can touch their routing scope.

jessica_cs: We have permission to tweak routing for mitigation. Please document and tag changes in the ticket. Customer acceptance criteria: webhooks success rate > 99.5% and embedding p95 < 300ms for 24h.

mike_se: I'll open a small PR to revert the quantization rollback and run a canary against their tenant only. Will drop the PR link in the ticket. ETA: PR + canary by EOD PST.

ollie_support: Heads-up: Customer is escalating to their CTO if we don't have a clear plan by EOD. They also want a short runbook for retry/backoff behavior we recommend.

rana_devops: Added a monitoring dashboard widget and alert for webhook 5xx rate + embed p95. Put a temporary suppression on pager for low-severity while we do the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-redwood-small-revert -> prod-dedicated (initiated by mike_se)

mike_se: Canary reports look good for the first 30m: success rate 99.8%, p95 embed 240ms. Rolling out to full tenant pool now.

jessica_cs: Fantastic. Please put a short summary in #CS-3421 and include the before/after metrics. I'll update the renewal owner and legal with mitigation notes.

ollie_support: I'll draft the runbook and attach it to the ticket. Also scheduling a 30-min sync with the customer tomorrow to walk through what we changed.

rana_devops: After rollout we'll monitor for 24h and then decide whether to leave surge in place or scale down. Will also create a follow-up action to audit quantization config change history.

jessica_cs: Great work team. Ping me if anything regresses. Otherwise I'll mark this as mitigated in the renewal tracker and follow up on the contract side. :thumbsup:
